deploy.on_merge: Vercel's Git integration builds main and deploys production at https://fomoengine.io (also served at www.fomoengine.io and fomoengine-cambridgetcgs-projects.vercel.app). .vercelignore leaves brand/ out of the upload; public/ holds the served copies
deploy.after_deploy: Vercel answers public, max-age=0, must-revalidate and its edge cache is per deployment, so no purge (measured 2026-11-05). Then check per wiring.md §7: /favicon.ico, /favicon.svg, /apple-touch-icon.png, /icon-*.png and /site.webmanifest answer 200 with their types and the kit's bytes, /opengraph-image answers 200 image/png, and og:image sits in <head> for the crawler user agents
deploy.rules: /AGENTS.md: no KPIs, revenue or growth targets, paid enrolment, checkout or launch obligations. /PLEDGE.md: the free path is never gated or degraded (free-tier.guardrail.test.ts in CI). A merge to main deploys production, so it needs Yu's word, or the repository owner's, for that merge; agents open PRs, the cambridgetcg account merges

media.name: share card (the site's own, not the kit's og.jpg)
media.goes_to: rendered by next/og at /opengraph-image (1200x630 PNG) on each request; every openGraph block names it through lib/share-card.ts SHARE_CARD. Hand-written JSX, not a Craft piece; its 'evidence.Keep' run-on (review-2026-11-02 item A1) was set as two lines on 2026-11-10
media.source: agents: first made in c77a161 (2026-06-09, git name "Asha Veridian"), redrawn in a3a8f44 (2026-09-08, git name "Nuance"); both commits carry a Claude co-author trailer

notes: The three guards run in CI through npm test (tsx --test "lib/**/*.test.ts" in package.json), which .github/workflows/shield-guardrail.yml runs on every push to main and every pull request. Neither file names the two tests: the glob picks them up. lib/brand-folder.test.ts runs brand/check.mjs; lib/brand-kit.sync.test.ts holds public/ to kit/web and the layout's head (icons, one theme-color, colorScheme only light, SHARE_CARD on every openGraph block).

kit/source/mark-small.svg, which draws the 16-48 px favicons, drops the two diagonal spokes and thickens the strokes; its comment calls it 'the same ring and hub', which isn't exact, and it stays as written because the kit holds a byte copy (PR #4).

kit/BRAND.md says Fraunces' licence 'was not checked': the font's name table says SIL OFL 1.1, and BRAND.md stays as generated. JetBrains Mono (colour-sheet labels) is bundled with vectorcraft-cli, so it has no file to list.
The site loads Fraunces and DM Sans itself through next/font/google; CREDITS.md lists them.
public/logo.svg ('eunoia-logo'), next.svg and vercel.svg are template leftovers, not kit files.
